interpretation.cause: The retained WO-09 JSON does not support all six trials returning near 100 percent. CPU trials 1-3 were near 100 percent. Peak trials 4-6 had medians 1.72558, 28.35959375, and 1.8503375 percent. The unchanged legacy formula already excludes Process.Id 0. A universal 100-percent defect is not established. SDK gap causes and independent utilization semantics remain unqualified.
interpretation.gapCause: SDK gaps are estimated unaccounted sampling periods. Exact cause of each gap is not qualified without raw event audit and WPA.
interpretation.historicalWo09: Original JSON remains unchanged. Original WO-09 ETLs were disposed; exact replay is unavailable.
